formal_training_step.analytic: the formal path differs from those three only where the vocabulary enters: every [8,192 x 151,936] tensor of the full-vocabulary path -- the student's and the teacher's logits (2.32 GiB each in bf16), CE's gathered rows widened to fp32 and the log-softmax it keeps (about 4.6 GiB each), KD's gathered student and teacher rows (2.32 GiB each) -- is replaced by 512-row blocks (0.29 GiB in fp32, a few at a time) at the target positions only; weights, AdamW state, the teacher and checkpointed activations are unchanged.
